title: A night in the Pu Luong valley
pace: One valley, on foot or a bicycle
summary: One night in a stilt house and the next morning on the terraces. Thursday or Sunday, Pho Doan is the other morning.

days.title: Day 1 — Evening in the hamlet
days.body: Sleep in a stilt house. After dark the hamlet floor is a campfire, jar wine, and dance. A start time is Check on arrival.

days.title: Day 2 — Morning on the terraces
days.body: Walk or cycle the fields while the mist is still on the slopes. Late May to early June is the green crop. September and October are the gold crop. On Thursday or Sunday, Pho Doan is the other morning. A loop hour is Check on arrival.

stops.name: Valley terraces
stops.note: Walk or cycle the terrace edges in the morning.

stops.name: Bamboo sticky rice
stops.note: Eat bamboo-tube rice at the stilt house.

stops.name: Jar wine
stops.note: Have jar wine with the campfire after dark.

seoTitle: A night in the Pu Luong valley
seoDescription: One night in a stilt house and a morning on the terraces. Rice is green in late May to early June and gold in September and October.
